traps: a Terraform module is a folder of .tf files: there is no single manifest; the root module's terraform block is in versions.tf, the child's in modules/network/main.tf
no file names a module: both units have name null and are referred to by their root; network is only the label of the call in main.tf
./modules/network is a local module: depends_on; cloudposse/label/null is a registry module: an external dependency
.terraform.lock.hcl locks providers only: the registry module version 0.25.0 is exact in main.tf but never locked
one provider, two constraints: the lock records the union ">= 3.5.0, ~> 3.6" and one version 3.6.3 for both modules
the lock carries only zh: hashes (the SHA256SUMS of the release zips); a lock written by terraform init also has an h1: hash per platform used
the provider is named by its source address hashicorp/random, which stands for registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/random
